text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Ravi (new Eng Manager) starts Mon 09:30 PT. Dropping a compact manager onboarding checklist here. Please confirm your pieces by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before checklist:
- Device shipped and imaged
- Okta + MFA invite sent
- Slack + email + calendar created
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers granted
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Intro 1:1s pre-scheduled (director, skip-level, team kickoff)

Sam (IT): Device imaged (MacBook Pro). Shipping label created, ETA Fri 3pm. Will add Docker, VSCode, and kubeconfig for eng-dev.

Alex (Eng): I can be the buddy for week 1. Will run infra walkthrough and team norms session.

Lena (People Ops): I’ll send the welcome email with a short "what to expect" and links to required training (security, data handling, manager anti-bias).

Maya (People Ops): Week 1 manager agenda (short):
Mon 09:30 - welcome + ops (15m)
Mon 10:00 - team kickoff (30m)
Tue - buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m)
Wed - product context + PM intro (30m)
Thu - 30/60/90 draft session (45m)
Fri - skip-level intro + week1 retro (30m)

Maya (People Ops): 30/60/90 bullets to draft (one-liner each):
30d: meet team, ship an onboarding win, review service metrics
60d: run sprint planning, propose two process improvements
90d: lead roadmap for a feature area, hiring plan inputs ready

Alex (Eng): Please add hiring rubric link to the welcome pack so Ravi can review before meeting recruiting.

Maya (People Ops): Added. Who-to-ask mapping:
- Payroll & comp: Lena
- Hardware & accounts: Sam
- Infra access: Alex / platform channel
- Security & compliance: eng-security channel

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Ravi - prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.

Sam (IT): :white_check_mark: Device + imaging done.

Alex (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + schedule.

Lena (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Welcome email queued.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. I’ll post the final Notion note and DM Ravi the first-week agenda. If anything else pops up, drop it here.

Ravi (new-hire): Thanks team! Looking forward to Monday — appreciate the clarity on access and the agenda.
